This includes understanding the integration of software and hardware devices, which is a key aspect of Computer Engineering [S3] [S4]. For embedded systems, you might look into courses that emphasize computer systems, embedded systems, digital logic, computer architecture, and the integration of hardware and software [S4]. Lastly, for software development, you can focus on courses that cover computation, algorithms, theory, programming languages, and software foundations [S4].
